title: Create src/tui/TasksApp.tsx — rocket tasks TUI
description: Create the root Ink component for the rocket tasks command. Shows a paginated list of tasks with status icons. Supports keyboard navigation.
acceptanceCriteria: ✓ icon shown for complete tasks (passes: true)
○ icon shown for incomplete tasks (passes: false)
Selected task is highlighted in cyan

steps.details: Create the file. Define props: { tasks: Task[]; initialFilter?: string }. Import React, useState, Box, Text, useInput from ink. Import Task from tasks/schema.ts.

steps.description: Implement task list with selection state
steps.details: const [selectedIndex, setSelectedIndex] = useState(0). useInput((input, key) => { if (key.upArrow) setSelectedIndex(i => Math.max(0, i-1)); if (key.downArrow) setSelectedIndex(i => Math.min(filteredTasks.length-1, i+1)) })

steps.description: Render task list with status icons
steps.details: Render each task: const icon = task.passes ? '✓' : '○'; const isSelected = index === selectedIndex. Return: <Text color={isSelected ? 'cyan' : undefined}>{icon} #{task.id} {task.title}</Text>

technicalNotes: For large task lists, implement virtual scrolling by only rendering a window of tasks around the selected index
